text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You've been staring at me for a while
now. There
something you need from the
great Sweepy?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Um, well, I was wondering if you'd let
me borrow
your magical girl clothes and
stuff. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I want to be a cute magical girl. That'd be so grammable!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It'd be nice to have another magical girl
around,
but why now of all times?
Couldn't you have said
something
earlier?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well, I would have asked sooner... but I
just
couldn't work up the courage...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you're the one and only
Sweepy... I've
admired your magicalness
for so long!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Oh, you don't... mind, do you?
Sniffy-sniff...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
W-well, I guess it's fine! Look, I'll lend
you some
clothes already, okay?
